bannedComboCheck.note: Base is white; tint sections are sage-grey #E9EFE7, not cream. Abril Fatface is a serif display = 1. Buttons are 6px-radius rectangles, not pills. Hero is full-screen, not a boxed card.

business: St Lucie Bakery at Bayshore, Port St. Lucie, FL, USA
colourStrategy: White base #FFFFFF, deep oxblood red #6E1F1A panels, olive green #4A5D3A accent, pale sage-grey tint #E9EFE7 (green-grey, not cream). No orange UI accents anywhere.
hero: Full-screen photo with dark overlay: stacked cannoli pile, headline and two calls to action
imageNotes: All 23 photos are Pexels, free-licensed, converted to WebP 1600px + 800px srcset, every file under 250 KB. Every kept photo was opened and checked for actual subject versus trade before use (84 candidates viewed across 7 contact sheets). Rejected: nachos, coffee beans as tiramisu, cheese fondue, pizza-making, cheeseburgers on a grill, a Five Guys storefront, a branded 'LODY' ice-cream shop, a 'Gifted patisseries' branded apron, a rice-paddy farm, a concert crowd, a supermarket aisle, a clothing market, peaches/apples as pie, a portrait of a woman drinking coffee, a wall logo, and a bakery case with rupee price tags. One candidate (cannoli on a tray, Pexels 12503509) was rejected at full-size check because the paper under the cannoli carries another cafe's name. A lattice apple pie (Pexels 12782728) was also dropped after the build, because apple pie is not a verified product on the bakery's menu. No image ID is reused from design-log.json (checked programmatically; 5 overlapping candidates found and replaced). Gallery carries a note that photos show the kind of food the bakery makes and are not the bakery's own photographs.
originalityCheck: Checked 2026-11-10 against design-log.json: archetype 'Village market' is NOT in the last 10 (Clean clinical/modern, Dark luxury minimal, Full-bleed cinematic, Retro poster, Scrolling story/timeline, Split-screen sticky side, Asymmetric photo collage, Light botanical atelier, Centered ceremonial, Swiss grid). Type pairing Abril Fatface + Work Sans is not used in the log. No image ID reused from the log. Combination differs from the only other Village market entry (village-bakery-caerleon, 28 Oct, Newsreader+Sora, white/sage/forest, full-photo hero with overlapping info card, ticket visit card, masonry gallery) on hero, fonts, colour, signature elements and section order (5 of 6 axes). Differs from the 8 Nov Norma's Sweets Bakery demo (asymmetric collage, Spectral + Public Sans) on all 6 axes.
signatureElements: Scrolling marquee strip with the bakery's Italian words (Cannoli, Tiramisu, Crumb Cake, Fresh Pasta, Italian Deli)
Tabbed bakery case (All / Pastries / Cakes) with a photo on every card
Saturday giant cinnamon rolls feature band with crumb-cake callout
Deli and Italian market section with a fresh-pasta photo feature row
typePairing: Abril Fatface (display) + Work Sans (body) — self-hosted woff2 in fonts/ (Google Fonts OFL), with a minimal self-hosted Bootstrap Icons subset (22 icons used); no CDN dependency at runtime. Note: this VM's headless Chromium has no direct internet access (proxy env not picked up), so CDN fonts/icons rendered blank in local captures; self-hosting makes the site verifiable locally and robust live. Same precedent as K. Brothers (8 Nov) and Posh Petals (9 Nov).
